summary: Tested new Emergent Object Storage + Whisper transcription pipeline end-to-end. Backend 6/6 pytest passing. Frontend Studio upload dialog with file inputs works: files upload to /api/files/... and text inputs populate correctly. Watch page 'Generate captions' -> 'Captions on' flow works in ~2s for tiny mp3, <track data-testid=video-captions-track> is injected, and /api/content/{id}/subtitles.vtt returns text/vtt starting with WEBVTT. Caching (second transcribe returns cached:true) verified. All acceptance criteria from the review request are met.
critical_code_review_comments: storage_get raises for 404 as HTTPStatusError → /api/files/{path} returns 502 for missing objects; would be cleaner to map external 404 → 404.
MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES=100MB is enforced only after full read into memory (await file.read()). Large uploads consume RAM before 413. Consider streaming or checking Content-Length header.
Whisper 25MB check uses 25*1024*1024, but OpenAI's actual limit is 25MB with some overhead. Acceptable.
ai_transcribe: when stream_url is not /api/files/, external fetches follow redirects and may 403 (as noted for pixabay) - error surface is 502 with message which is OK.
resolveMedia: works correctly - /api/... paths are prefixed with backend origin, full https URLs left as-is (verified via test).
test_credentials: Dynamic TESTUI_* / Passw0rd! users registered per run.
seed_data_creation: None - test users create their own channels/content via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend storage/whisper tests: /app/backend/tests/test_storage_whisper.py. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest -n 0 backend/tests/test_storage_whisper.py. Original iteration_1 issues (AI-chat FAB z-index vs Emergent badge, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget) still open per iteration_1 - not re-verified in this iteration since out of scope. Whisper on 3-second silent mp3 returns text 'you' as expected. Caching persists in db.content.subtitles_vtt field.
rca of the issue: N/A - no new issues found in this iteration.
